goal: Ship the first reusable orchestration engine for vibe coders.
globalAcceptanceCriteria: The orchestrator can store a durable plan graph.
The supervisor can choose the next ready task deterministically.
The project can be extended with stack-specific profiles later.

tasks.title: Create domain model
tasks.description: Define the core plan, task, workspace, and profile contracts.

tasks.title: Implement supervisor selection loop
tasks.description: Pick the next ready task from a plan graph using deterministic rules.
acceptanceCriteria: A ready task is selected deterministically.

tasks.title: Design durable memory layer
tasks.description: Add memory tiers and artifact references for large-project continuity.

tasks.title: Outline chat and task board UX
tasks.description: Describe the first visible product surfaces for the orchestrator.
acceptanceCriteria: The first product surfaces are named and scoped.
